## applyUpdates {#symbol-function-applyupdates}

```{.ts filename="TypeScript"}
function applyUpdates(updates, options): Promise<UpdateResult>;
```

Defined in: [packages/core/src/operations/update.ts:770](https://github.com/mcanouil/quarto-wizard/blob/b7d550a185f5d7e29506b5543328795c41204575/packages/core/src/operations/update.ts#L770)

Apply updates to extensions.

An update never replaces an extension with local changes: that extension goes
to `skipped` with the reason `local-edits`, and the other updates continue.
An update replaces a copy at the same version too, because a new tag or
commit can keep the manifest version.

An aborted `signal` stops the running install. That update and every
update after it go to `skipped`, and the result keeps the updates that
were already installed.

### Parameters

| Parameter | Type                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | Description      |
| --------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------- |
| `updates` | `<code><a href="operations.qmd#symbol-interface-updateinfo" style="text-decoration-line: underline; text-decoration-style: dashed; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-decoration-color: currentColor;">UpdateInfo</a>[]</code>`{=html} | Updates to apply |
| `options` | [`UpdateOptions`](operations.qmd#symbol-interface-updateoptions)                                                                                                                                                                         | Update options   |

### Returns

`<code>Promise&lt;<a href="operations.qmd#symbol-interface-updateresult" style="text-decoration-line: underline; text-decoration-style: dashed; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-decoration-color: currentColor;">UpdateResult</a>&gt;</code>`{=html}

Update result

## checkForUpdates {#symbol-function-checkforupdates}

```{.ts filename="TypeScript"}
function checkForUpdates(options): Promise<UpdateCheckResult>;
```

Defined in: [packages/core/src/operations/update.ts:240](https://github.com/mcanouil/quarto-wizard/blob/b7d550a185f5d7e29506b5543328795c41204575/packages/core/src/operations/update.ts#L240)

Check for available updates.

The update mode of the install record picks the comparison. Branch mode
compares the installed commit with the head of the tracked branch, the
default branch unless the source names one. Tag mode compares the installed
version with the latest tag, and an update never goes to a lower version.
While the repository has no version tag, tag mode compares commits on the
default branch, when the install recorded a commit.

A source with a repository subdirectory is always checked on GitHub. Its
installed version is compared with the version in the subdirectory manifest
at the latest tag, because the tags of a repository that holds several
extensions need not follow the version of any one of them.

An extension embedded in an installed parent is not checked, because it
changes only when its parent is updated.

An aborted `signal` stops the requests and rejects with a
`CancellationError`.

### Parameters

| Parameter | Type                                                                       | Description   |
| --------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------- |
| `options` | [`UpdateCheckOptions`](operations.qmd#symbol-interface-updatecheckoptions) | Check options |

### Returns

`<code>Promise&lt;<a href="operations.qmd#symbol-interface-updatecheckresult" style="text-decoration-line: underline; text-decoration-style: dashed; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-decoration-color: currentColor;">UpdateCheckResult</a>&gt;</code>`{=html}

Available updates and the failures met on the way

## install {#symbol-function-install}

```{.ts filename="TypeScript"}
function install(source, options): Promise<InstallResult>;
```

Defined in: [packages/core/src/operations/install.ts:372](https://github.com/mcanouil/quarto-wizard/blob/b7d550a185f5d7e29506b5543328795c41204575/packages/core/src/operations/install.ts#L372)

Install an extension from a source.

### Parameters

| Parameter | Type                                                               | Description          |
| --------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ | -------------------- |
| `source`  | [`InstallSource`](operations.qmd#symbol-typealias-installsource)   | Installation source  |

Installation result

### Example

```{.typescript filename="TypeScript"}
// Install from GitHub
const source = parseInstallSource("quarto-ext/fontawesome");
const result = await install(source, { projectDir: "." });

// Install with progress tracking
await install(source, {
  projectDir: ".",
  onProgress: ({ phase, message }) => console.log(`[${phase}] ${message}`),
});
```

## installedVersionFloor {#symbol-function-installedversionfloor}

```{.ts filename="TypeScript"}
function installedVersionFloor(installedVersion, recordedRef): string | null;
```

Defined in: [packages/core/src/operations/versions.ts:96](https://github.com/mcanouil/quarto-wizard/blob/b7d550a185f5d7e29506b5543328795c41204575/packages/core/src/operations/versions.ts#L96)

Version that an update must exceed when the installed version is not a
version, or null when there is none.

A version with more than three numeric parts, such as the development build
"1.0.0.9000", is ahead of its first three parts, so a tag equal to them is
not newer. Any other installed version gives the version of the tag recorded
in the manifest source, so that an update never goes below that tag.

### Parameters

| Parameter          | Type               | Description                                                     |
| ------------------ | ------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `installedVersion` | `string`           | Version in the installed manifest                               |
| `recordedRef`      | `string` \| `null` | Tag recorded in the manifest source, or null when there is none |

### Returns

`string` \| `null`

## parseInstallSource {#symbol-function-parseinstallsource}

```{.ts filename="TypeScript"}
function parseInstallSource(input, checkExists?): InstallSource;
```

Defined in: [packages/core/src/operations/install.ts:239](https://github.com/mcanouil/quarto-wizard/blob/b7d550a185f5d7e29506b5543328795c41204575/packages/core/src/operations/install.ts#L239)

Parse an install source string.

### Parameters

| Parameter      | Type                  | Default value   | Description                                    |
| -------------- | --------------------- | --------------- | ---------------------------------------------- |
| `input`        | `string`              | `undefined`     | Source string (GitHub ref, URL, or local path) |
| `checkExists?` | (`path`) => `boolean` | `fs.existsSync` | -                                              |

### Returns

[`InstallSource`](operations.qmd#symbol-typealias-installsource)

Parsed InstallSource

### Example

```{.typescript filename="TypeScript"}
// GitHub reference
parseInstallSource("quarto-ext/fontawesome");
// { type: "github", owner: "quarto-ext", repo: "fontawesome", version: { type: "latest" } }

// GitHub with version
parseInstallSource("quarto-ext/lightbox@v1.0.0");
// { type: "github", ..., version: { type: "tag", tag: "v1.0.0" } }

// URL
parseInstallSource("https://example.com/ext.zip");
// { type: "url", url: "https://example.com/ext.zip" }

// Local path
parseInstallSource("./my-extension");
// { type: "local", path: "./my-extension" }
```

## planSourceChange {#symbol-function-plansourcechange}

```{.ts filename="TypeScript"}
function planSourceChange(extension, options): Promise<SourceChange | null>;
```

Defined in: [packages/core/src/operations/source.ts:114](https://github.com/mcanouil/quarto-wizard/blob/b7d550a185f5d7e29506b5543328795c41204575/packages/core/src/operations/source.ts#L114)

Compute the target of a change of update source.

Tag to branch targets the head of the default branch. Branch to tag targets
the latest version tag, which can be below the installed version, and drops
an explicit branch. A repository without a version tag targets the head of
the default branch in tag mode, as a first install in tag mode would.

### Parameters

| Parameter   | Type                                                                       | Description         |
| ----------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------- |
| `extension` | [`InstalledExtension`](filesystem.qmd#symbol-interface-installedextension) | Installed extension |
| `options`   | [`GitHubOptions`](github.qmd#symbol-interface-githuboptions)               | GitHub options      |

### Returns

`<code>Promise&lt;<a href="operations.qmd#symbol-interface-sourcechange" style="text-decoration-line: underline; text-decoration-style: dashed; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-decoration-color: currentColor;">SourceChange</a> | null&gt;</code>`{=html}

Target to install, or null when the source is not on GitHub

### Throws

ExtensionError when the default branch has no commit to install

## useBrand {#symbol-function-usebrand}

```{.ts filename="TypeScript"}
function useBrand(source, options): Promise<UseBrandResult>;
```

Defined in: [packages/core/src/operations/brand.ts:624](https://github.com/mcanouil/quarto-wizard/blob/b7d550a185f5d7e29506b5543328795c41204575/packages/core/src/operations/brand.ts#L624)

Download and apply a Quarto brand to a project.

Downloads/extracts the source, finds the brand YAML file, extracts referenced
asset paths, and copies the brand file (renamed to _brand.yml) plus assets
into the project's _brand/ directory.

### Parameters

| Parameter | Type                                                                         | Description                            |
| --------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------- |
| `source`  | `string` \| [`InstallSource`](operations.qmd#symbol-typealias-installsource) | Brand source (string or InstallSource) |
| `options` | [`UseBrandOptions`](operations.qmd#symbol-interface-usebrandoptions)         | Use brand options                      |

### Returns

`<code>Promise&lt;<a href="operations.qmd#symbol-interface-usebrandresult" style="text-decoration-line: underline; text-decoration-style: dashed; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-decoration-color: currentColor;">UseBrandResult</a>&gt;</code>`{=html}

Use brand result

### Example

```{.typescript filename="TypeScript"}
const result = await useBrand("mcanouil/quarto-mcanouil", {
  projectDir: "/path/to/project",
  onProgress: ({ phase, message }) => console.log(`[${phase}] ${message}`),
});
```
